changelog: The installer now idempotently repairs ownership and privileges for VoxyWatch tables and dependent sequences before applying the baseline and migrations.
This prevents CDR write, rollup read, and runtime index failures caused by application objects inherited from a different owner.
changelog_es: El instalador repara de forma idempotente la propiedad y los privilegios de las tablas y secuencias propias de VoxyWatch antes de aplicar el baseline y las migr
